signIn.title: Investor sign-in
signIn.intro: Enter your email address and password to open the investor room.
signIn.error: That email address and password do not match.
signIn.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
signIn.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

setPassword.title: Choose your password
setPassword.intro: Set the password you will use to sign in to the investor room.
setPassword.hint: At least 12 characters, and not a common password.
setPassword.tooCommon: That password is too common. Choose a less predictable one.
setPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
setPassword.expiredBody: It may have been used already, or it has expired. Ask your administrator for a new invitation, or request another reset.
setPassword.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
